attempts.raw_response:
These shows are often held in basements, warehouses, or small venues that don't have the resources for major advertising. Finding them usually requires knowing someone who knows someone, which adds to the exclusivity and appeal. You might discover a band at one of these shows before they sign their first record deal, giving you serious bragging rights later when they become famous.

The music at underground shows tends to be more experimental and less polished than what you hear on the radio. This authenticity is exactly what many hipsters are looking for. They want to feel like they're part of a movement before it goes mainstream, when the music still feels personal and the connection to the artist is real. Supporting small businesses and discovering underground music both reflect a desire to be different and to invest in things that feel genuine rather than mass-produced.

pair.human_continuation: Many of the artists and bands that you’ll want to listen to will be “indie” or independent musicians without a major record label. Indie music is a staple genre in any hipster’s music library.  Your local record shop will have plenty of flyers and people who can tell you where to find shows and what bands are up and coming. In addition to indie music, any vintage or old music. Your music tastes are how you can show people that you’re cultured and well-rounded. Even though you’re looking to enter the hipster subculture, you can stay true to your own music tastes. Indie and classic music has so many different subgenres that you’re bound to find some new favorites.

As a hipster, you want to support smaller business and start-up companies instead of the big, overbearing corporations that run the country.  The attitude behind shop local for some hipsters is that big companies don’t need more money and don’t care about you anyways. Getting to know the businesses in your area is a better way to avoid being mainstream.
Secret or 'underground' shows are a great way to find new bands to listen to that only a small group of people know about yet.
